title: Five layout records initialize slots 50 through 54
claim: LevelLayout_SpawnGroup317A4C initializes five consecutive entity slots from sLevelLayoutPtrs[0..4], with kind 0x47, flags 16, field14 = 0x111 + 4*(i%5), and final byte arguments 5,3,3. The u8 loop and existing narrow initializer signature reproduce all 88 target bytes without pins. The group identity beyond its data anchor is not established.

title: Three cursor entries select the main-loop route
claim: Menu_ApplyCursorRoute maps cursor 0/1/2 to routerSelection1/2/3 and clears the two dispatch bytes. Other cursor values leave state unchanged. AgbMain interprets these routes as FILE_SELECT, OPTIONS, and MENU_07 respectively. A direct three-case switch matches all 72 bytes without pins.

title: Timer setup retains pointer updates through post-increment assignments
claim: Historical campaign candidate uses an ordinary pointer to volatile timer halfwords with *timerRegisters++ = *config++; *timerRegisters-- = *config;. This reproduces the target register-write tail; separate pointer-update statements did not. No volatile pointer object is required. The full candidate still differs by seven bytes/five IRQ-mask instructions, so the live function remains assembly.

title: Combine folds timer index load into the shift count
claim: Standalone reproduction with installed old_agbcc preserves index-load-before-constant order through RTL expansion and CSE. Combine deletes the byte load and folds its MEM into the shift count; reload materializes the load after constant 8 and assigns the observed swapped registers. This explains the current candidate residual, not a matching source solution. Next discriminating test is a private diagnostic veto of that substitution, followed by stock-compiler source investigation.
